identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.26. 2.0.24: new characters no longer get a Last Location pin on the spawn map; they choose a town. 2.0.25: switching characters no longer carries the previous character's tattoos and makeup onto a character loaded from an older RSG/VORP skin, and they are no longer saved to that character. 2.0.26: removing painted (Color) MP clothes with /boots or /pants no longer leaves the feet or the lower body invisible, and /boots no longer refuses with "This clothing combination cannot be changed safely" after a color change in the clothing store.

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.138: livery tabs on the same car now combine (Ironhorse taxi livery with any wheel colour).

gym.message: RCO Gym 0.0.92: more than one gym. Config.Gyms lists them (Strawberry comes ready, with its blip and record board); add one anywhere station by station, its type and the spot the player stands on, and the script lays its equipment out. Config.Blip moved into each gym's entry.
